method: Actual final terrain triangles and actual global tram curves; rail-centre radial depth plus oriented union vehicle bounding envelope at each ~1m station. Envelope/triangle contact is conservative, not exact loaded train mesh collision.
limitations: Body bounds use actual current locomotive/wagon subtree vertices; future robot/cargo configurations and all moving running-gear extrema are not proven.
About 1m arc-length samples are discrete, not continuous swept triangle clearance.
No continuous between-sample guarantee; union envelope can report empty space inside vehicle bounds.
Positive radial depth assumes the r17 mountain is a filled heightfield; only upward actual surface intersections are used.
Track, trains and terrain are read-only snapshots; no route or mountain edit.
